docs.title: Machine Learning for Particle Accelerators
docs.text:
The MaLAPA collaboration connects researchers advancing machine learning-based systems at particle accelerator facilities worldwide.

Next workshop: Berkeley, April 26–29, 2027 Subscribe for announcements

docs.title: Our mission
docs.text: Our mission is to connect researchers in the field and advance the deployment of machine learning-based systems to particle accelerator facilities to ultimately enable the next generation of accelerators and novel scientific applications.

docs.title: Subscribe
docs.text:
Get announcements about upcoming MaLAPA workshops from the malapa-announce mailing list.

Click for a pre-filled email Or email listserv@fnal.gov with this body Subscribe Subscribe SUBSCRIBE malapa-announce Your Name Unsubscribe Unsubscribe SIGNOFF malapa-announce

Reply OK to the confirmation email to finish subscribing. Unsubscribe from the same address you subscribed with.

You can also create an optional account at listserv.fnal.gov to subscribe, unsubscribe, or change your settings online.

docs.title: Living Review
docs.text: The Living Review of Machine Learning for Particle Accelerators is a continuously updated collection of literature on machine learning applied to particle accelerators. Browse it or contribute on GitHub: MALAPA-Collab/AccML-LivingReview.
